rules.sentence: When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is not `ALL '0'`, it opens `CONTROL-FILE` for input, `ACCT-FILE`, `CARD-FILE`, and `HOLD-FILE` to update, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; displays `'AUTHSRV: CANNOT OPEN FILES '` `WS-FILE-STATUSES`; sets `RETURN-CODE` to 16; and stops the run.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds no more records, it opens `CONTROL-FILE` for input, `ACCT-FILE`, `CARD-FILE`, and `HOLD-FILE` to update, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'NO BANK CONTROL RECORD'`; and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds a record, it opens `CONTROL-FILE` for input, `ACCT-FILE`, `CARD-FILE`, and `HOLD-FILE` to update, and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; and performs `1100-FIND-LAST-HOLD`.

rules.sentence: When positioning `HOLD-FILE` fails on its key, it sets `HD-KEY` to low values, runs `START HOLD-FILE KEY IS NOT LESS THAN HD-KEY`, sets `WS-HOLDS-END-SW` to `END-OF-HOLDS`, and repeats its loop until `WS-HOLDS-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`END-OF-HOLDS`).

When positioning `HOLD-FILE` succeeds by its key, it sets `HD-KEY` to low values, runs `START HOLD-FILE KEY IS NOT LESS THAN HD-KEY`, and repeats its loop until `WS-HOLDS-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`END-OF-HOLDS`).

conditions: READ HOLD-FILE NEXT RECORD AT END

rules.sentence: When reading `HOLD-FILE` finds no more records, it reads `HOLD-FILE` and sets `WS-HOLDS-END-SW` to `END-OF-HOLDS`.
When reading `HOLD-FILE` finds a record and `HD-HOLD-NO` is more than `WS-LAST-HOLD-NO`, it reads `HOLD-FILE` and sets `WS-LAST-HOLD-NO` to `HD-HOLD-NO`.
When reading `HOLD-FILE` finds a record and `HD-HOLD-NO` is at most `WS-LAST-HOLD-NO`, it reads `HOLD-FILE`.
When `ACCEPT AUTH-REQUEST` raises on exception, it accepts `AUTH-REQUEST` from its input and sets `WS-INPUT-END-SW` to `END-OF-INPUT`.
When `ACCEPT AUTH-REQUEST` does not raise on exception, it accepts `AUTH-REQUEST` from its input, performs `2100-AUTHORIZE`, and displays `AUTH-RESPONSE`.

rules.sentence: When rewriting `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD` fails on its key, it rewrites `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD`, sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'CANNOT REWRITE THE ACCOUNT'`, and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When rewriting `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD` succeeds by its key and rewriting `CARD-RECORD` fails on its key, it rewrites `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD`, rewrites `CARD-RECORD`, sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'CANNOT REWRITE THE CARD'`, and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When rewriting `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD` succeeds by its key, rewriting `CARD-RECORD` succeeds by its key, `RQ-FUNCTION` is `'REVS'` (`RQ-REVERSAL`), and rewriting `HOLD-RECORD` fails on its key, it rewrites `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD`, rewrites `CARD-RECORD`, rewrites `HOLD-RECORD`, sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'CANNOT REWRITE THE HOLD'`, and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When rewriting `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD` succeeds by its key, rewriting `CARD-RECORD` succeeds by its key, `RQ-FUNCTION` is `'REVS'` (`RQ-REVERSAL`), and rewriting `HOLD-RECORD` succeeds by its key, it rewrites `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD`, rewrites `CARD-RECORD`, rewrites `HOLD-RECORD`, and adds `HD-AMOUNT` to `WS-RELEASED-TOTAL`.

When rewriting `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD` succeeds by its key, rewriting `CARD-RECORD` succeeds by its key, `RQ-FUNCTION` is not `'REVS'` (not `RQ-REVERSAL`), and writing `HOLD-RECORD` fails on its key, it rewrites `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD`; rewrites `CARD-RECORD`; adds 1 to `WS-LAST-HOLD-NO`; sets `HD-HOLD-NO` and `RS-AUTH-CODE` to `WS-LAST-HOLD-NO`; writes `HOLD-RECORD`; sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'CANNOT WRITE THE HOLD'`; and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When rewriting `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD` succeeds by its key, rewriting `CARD-RECORD` succeeds by its key, `RQ-FUNCTION` is not `'REVS'` (not `RQ-REVERSAL`), and writing `HOLD-RECORD` succeeds by its key, it rewrites `ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD`; rewrites `CARD-RECORD`; adds 1 to `WS-LAST-HOLD-NO`; sets `HD-HOLD-NO` and `RS-AUTH-CODE` to `WS-LAST-HOLD-NO`; writes `HOLD-RECORD`; adds `HD-AMOUNT` to `WS-HELD-TOTAL`; and adds `HD-FEE` to `WS-HELD-TOTAL`.
